ios.desc:
Am I ready to pass? That's the only question that matters in the final weeks before your NCLEX — and it's the question this app is built to answer.

Set your exam date, work through the lessons, log your practice scores, and watch your readiness score update every day as test day gets closer. No more guessing. No more panic-scrolling Reddit at 2am asking if you're ready.

YOUR READINESS SCORE
• A personal readiness index built from your quiz results and practice scores
• Updates as you study, so you can see yourself getting closer to test-ready
• Set your own target and track your trend, day by day
• An exam-day countdown that keeps your studying focused on what's left, not what's behind

A LESSON LIBRARY THAT FEELS LIKE DUOLINGO, NOT A TEXTBOOK
• High-yield audio lectures covering the most-tested NCLEX topics: labs and hormones, priority and delegation, pharmacology, cardiac, OB, psych, and more
• Every lecture comes with a quiz, flashcards, and a one-page cram sheet
• Listen podcast-style on your commute, then lock it in with practice questions
• Bite-size by design — built for 20 minutes a day, not 8-hour library marathons

BUILT FOR THE FINAL STRETCH
• Made for the last weeks before your exam, when confidence matters as much as content
• Track which topics are strong and which need one more pass
• Cram sheets for the night before, so review takes minutes instead of hours

WHY NURSING STUDENTS CHOOSE US
• One clear number instead of scattered scores across five different apps
• Real human support — email us and a person replies within 24 hours
• Your data stays private. We never share your scores or study materials.

Start free today. Your exam date is coming either way — walk in knowing you're ready.


NCLEX® is a registered trademark of the National Council of State Boards of Nursing, Inc. (NCSBN®). This app is not endorsed, sponsored by, or affiliated with NCSBN®.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your study materials and quiz data stay private. We do not share your content with anyone.

Questions or feedback? Contact us at support@thinkfirstai.app

quotes.text:
I built this after noticing my brother was literally copying answers from ChatGPT and failing exams lol

The core idea is to provide hints first rather than instant answer like every AI tool. I believe it's gonna make Gen-Z dumb if they stop critical thinking, problem-solving skills.

Honest feedback welcome, especially criticism.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/thinkfirst-ai-homework-help/id6759180853
